# Auto to Rental

> Auto to Rental is an international multi-vendor car rental marketplace that connects travelers and residents directly with verified rental companies — with ZERO platform commission. Browse thousands of cars, compare daily, weekly and monthly rates, and contact rental companies directly by phone, WhatsApp or free in-app voice/video call. Available in 7 languages and 13 currencies, serving the UAE, Syria and a growing list of countries.

## What makes Auto to Rental different
- **Zero commission, direct contact.** The price you see is the price you pay. Customers reach rental companies directly — no middleman, no booking fees.
- **Verified companies only.** Every rental company is reviewed and verified (trade license + identity) before going live, shown with a green verified badge.
- **Multi-vendor marketplace.** Hundreds of independent rental companies list their fleets in one place, so customers compare across the whole market.
- **Car videos & live calls.** Many cars have short videos; customers can voice/video-call the company free inside the app to see the car live before renting.
- **Multilingual & multi-currency.** The entire site is available in English, Arabic, Spanish, Chinese, Thai, Russian and Urdu, with prices in 13 currencies.

## How it works
1. Browse or search cars by brand, city, body type, and daily/weekly/monthly budget.
2. Open a car to see photos, specs, price and the rental company.
3. Contact the company directly via phone, WhatsApp, or free in-app call — no commission, no booking fee.
4. Agree terms and rent directly with the verified company.

- [Browse all cars](https://autotorental.com/cars): Search and filter the full fleet by brand, city, body type and price.
- [Rental companies](https://autotorental.com/companies): Directory of verified rental companies with reviews and contact details.
- [Platform features](https://autotorental.com/features): Everything the platform offers for renters and for rental companies.
- [Brands](https://autotorental.com/brands): Browse rental cars by manufacturer.
- [Car Rental Dubai](https://autotorental.com/car-rental-dubai): Dubai car-rental landing page.
- [Dubai Airport car rental](https://autotorental.com/car-rental-dubai-airport): Pick-up and drop-off at Dubai International Airport (DXB).
- [Monthly car rental Dubai](https://autotorental.com/monthly-car-rental-dubai): Long-term monthly rental deals.
- [Weekly car rental Dubai](https://autotorental.com/weekly-car-rental-dubai): Weekly rental rates.
